'''''X-Wing''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting the eponymous [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted a [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] taking part in a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle against several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], with an [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigate]] and a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in the background.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Painting_container.jpg|thumb|The container used to store one of the three paintings.]]
The painting ''X-Wing'', alongside the paintings [[Imperial Star Destroyer (painting)|''Imperial Star Destroyer'']] and ''[[KSE Firespray]]'', was one of three bonus paintings that was unlockable as a result of players accessing ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' after the "Double Everything Weekend" event on the last days of ''The Empire Strike's Back'' 30th Anniversary Celebration. Accessing ''Galaxies'' after the Double Everything Weekend resulted in a painting container that contained in random one of the three above paintings, and could be opened using the radial menu.
